_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series D3CBA/1 Set-2. 24 page images: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-22 (each odd index 3-21 is the Hindi of the page after it); idx 23 (folio 24) is BLANK, the cover announces 23 printed pages. Odd-page tops checked against contact.png and at full size where it mattered (idx 21): all Hindi; question numbers run 1-39 unbroken across the even pages. Printed instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 x1, B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4; instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme for a bare OR: Q22, 24, 31, 34, 35, 36, 37(iii), 38(iii), 39(iii) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Case-study labels on this paper are (i)/(ii)/(iii)(A) OR (iii)(B), as on 31/1/1. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2, footer X SCIENCE 31/1/2); each re-derived: 18 agree, Q10 disagrees (flagged), Q9 arguable (flagged). No void or award-regardless note anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points on this paper are ordinary full stops (Q27: pH 4.6). SIBLING of 31/1/1: 42 of 54 rows are the same printed question as a 31/1/1 row, reshuffled and renumbered (case studies too: this paper's 37/38/39 are 31/1/1's 39/38/37), and carry 31/1/1's stem, context, options, answer, chapter, subtopic and difficulty byte for byte after reading each on this paper's own page; 12 rows are new to this set and transcribed fresh: Q4, Q8, Q23, Q24a, Q24b, Q25, Q26, Q30, Q32, Q33, Q34a, Q34b. One typesetting slip ignored in a copied row: Q38(i) prints 'F1 plants ?' with a space before the question mark where 31/1/1's row has 'plants?'. _figure notes are this paper's own, with this paper's page indices.
